name: 2D Platformer Game
description:
Jump-and-run game. Make your hero jump, avoid enemies, reach the flag.

     ╭─────╮
     │  ◆  │  <- Your Hero
     ╰─────╯
     
  ⚔  ⚔  ⚔ <- Enemies
  
  🚩 <- Goal
  
Customize: hero name, colors, difficulty, jump feel.

fields.label: Your hero's name
fields.help: Shown on screen and in the win message.

fields.label: Sky color
fields.help: Click the color button to pick a sky color.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.help: Easy has one slow enemy, hard has four fast ones.

fields.label: Jump feel
fields.help: Floaty = gentle jumps, heavy = quick falls.
